summary_en: A synthetic forest point cloud is peeled away layer by layer to reveal castle foundations and a stone arch, then condenses into a lit solid surface.
limits_en: Points are EEVEE point-cloud sprites, not strict soft discs; a slight squareness is visible up close.
Terrain micro-relief is procedural noise; it resembles hillshade of a real DEM but lacks its randomness.
The closing shot is a little farther away than in A (A ends close to the ground); the subject is kept mid-frame for 9:16 readability.
